test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter series and answer the question

Y H S D S Y I R A Y E U G I R O A B U B R X M P Q

How many such vowels are there in the series each of which is immediately preceded by a consonant and also immediately followed by a consonant?
solution:
Given series:

Y H S D S Y I R A Y E U G I R O A B U B R X M P Q

Condition to be checked:

A vowel immediately preceded by a consonant and immediately followed by a consonant.

This pattern can be represented as: Consonant → Vowel → Consonant

Le
